name: Aquaguard Premier
summary: Aquaguard Premier is an advanced RO water purifier designed for modern kitchens, combining RO purification, UV E-Boiling, Active Copper + Zinc Booster, and alkaline technology .
intro: Aquaguard Premier is an advanced RO water purifier featuring UV E-Boiling, Active Copper + Zinc Booster, and alkaline technology. It effectively removes impurities, heavy metals, bacteria, and viruses while enriching water with essential minerals. With smart alerts, 5-litre storage, long cartridge life, and wall/tabletop installation, it offers safe, convenient, and reliable drinking water for modern homes.
features: Active Copper + Zinc Booster Technology – Enriches water with copper and zinc while the alkaline cartridge enhances pH and taste.
UV E-Boiling Technology – Provides water as safe and pure as water boiled for over 20 minutes.
Advanced RO Purification – Helps remove heavy metals such as lead and mercury, along with bacteria and viruses.
Smart Purifier Alerts – Alerts you about errors, service requirements, and cartridge replacement.
High Storage Capacity – Built-in storage tank keeps purified water readily available.
Smart LED Indication – Indicates tank-full status, filter life, service reminders, and errors.
Flexible Installation – Suitable for both wall mounting and tabletop installation.
Long Cartridge Life – Up to 1 year or 6,000 litres, under standard test conditions.
Energy-Saving Mode – UV lamp automatically switches off after 10 minutes of non-use.
RO Membrane Warranty – Free cleaning or replacement for up to 1 year or 6,000 litres.
